00047 class BufferChannelInternal : public SmartPointer
00048 {
00049 public:
00050   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, bool zeroData = false) throw();
00051   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const unsigned int sourceDataSize, const float* sourceData) throw();
00052   BufferChannelInternal(const unsigned int size, const double start, const double end) throw();
00053   ~BufferChannelInternal() throw();
00054   
00055   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const int index) const throw() { return data[index]; }
00056   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const double index) const throw() { return getSampleUnchecked((float)index); }
00057   inline float getSampleUnchecked(const float index) const throw() 
00058   { 
00059     const int iIndex0 = (int)index;
00060     unsigned int iIndex1 = iIndex0+1;
00061     if(iIndex1 >= size_)
00062       iIndex1 = 0;
00063     const float frac1 = (float)index - (float)iIndex0;
00064     const float frac0 = 1.f - frac1;
00065     
00066     return data[iIndex0] * frac0 + data[iIndex1] * frac1; // need to optimise this at some point    
00067   }

00406   template<class NumericalType>
00407   inline NumericalArray<NumericalType> toArray(const int channel) const throw()
00408   {
00409     NumericalArray<NumericalType> array;
00410     
00411     if(channels != 0)
00412     {
00413       int channelToUse = channel;
00414       while(channelToUse < 0)
00415         channelToUse += numChannels_;
00416       
00417       NumericalArray<float> floatArray = NumericalArray<float>::withArray(size_, 
00418                                         channels[channel % numChannels_]->data, 
00419                                         false);
00420       array = floatArray;
00421     }
00422     
00423     return array;
00424   }

00623   { 
00624     ugen_assert((channel >= 0) && (channel < numChannels_)); 
00625     BufferChannelInternal* internal = channels[channel];

00632   { 
00633     ugen_assert(channel >= 0); 
00634     BufferChannelInternal* internal = channels[channel % numChannels_];
00635     if(blockID == internal->currentWriteBlockID)
00636     {

00638     }
00639     else
00640     {
00641       return internal->circularHead;
00642     }

00779   template<UnaryOpFunction op>
00780   Buffer unary() const throw()                                        
00781   {                                                           
00782     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(size_, numChannels_, false));                             
00783     
00784     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < numChannels_; channelIndex++)                        
00785     {                                                         
00786       int numSamples = size_;                                           
00787       float* inputSamples = channels[channelIndex]->data;                               
00788       float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                          
00789       
00790       while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                            
00791         *outputSamples++ = op(*inputSamples++);                       
00792       }                                                     
00793     }                                                         
00794     
00795     return newBuffer;                                                 
00796   }

00814   template<BinaryOpFunction op>
00815   Buffer binary(Buffer rightOperand) throw()
00816   {
00817     const int newNumChannels = numChannels_ > rightOperand.numChannels_ ? numChannels_ : rightOperand.numChannels_; 
00818     const int maxSize = size_ > rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                  
00819     const int minSize = size_ < rightOperand.size_ ? size_ : rightOperand.size_;                  
00820     const int diffSize = maxSize-minSize;                                     
00821     
00822     Buffer newBuffer(BufferSpec(maxSize, newNumChannels, false));                         
00823     
00824     for(int channelIndex = 0; channelIndex < newNumChannels; channelIndex++)                    
00825     {                                                       
00826       int numSamples;                                               
00827       float* leftSamples = channels[channelIndex % numChannels_]->data;                     
00828       float* rightSamples = rightOperand.channels[channelIndex % rightOperand.numChannels_]->data;        
00829       float* outputSamples = newBuffer.channels[channelIndex]->data;                        
00830       
00831       if(size_ == 1 && numChannels_ == 1) {                                   
00832         numSamples = maxSize;                                         
00833         
00834         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00835           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples, *rightSamples++);           
00836         }                                                   
00837       } else if(rightOperand.size_ == 1 && rightOperand.numChannels_ == 1) {                  
00838         numSamples = maxSize;                                         
00839         
00840         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00841           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, *rightSamples);           
00842         }                                                   
00843       } else {                                                  
00844         numSamples = minSize;                                         
00845         while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                        
00846           *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, *rightSamples++);           
00847         }                                                   
00848         
00849         numSamples = diffSize;                                          
00850         if(size_ > rightOperand.size_) {                                    
00851           while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                      
00852             *outputSamples++ = op(*leftSamples++, 0.f);               
00853           }                                                 
00854         }                                                   
00855         else if(rightOperand.size_ > size_) {                                 
00856           while(--numSamples >= 0) {                                      
00857             *outputSamples++ = op(0.f, *rightSamples++);                
00858           }                                                 
00859         }                                                   
00860       }                                                     
00861     }                                                       
00862     
00863     return newBuffer;                                               
00864   }

00869   Buffer& operator/= (Buffer const& other) throw();
00870   Buffer& operator<<= (Buffer const& other) throw();

00877   bool isNull() const throw() { return size_ == 0 || numChannels_ == 0; }
